The next Northern Illinois Transit Authority (NITA) Board of Directors meeting is scheduled for 
December 10, 2026, at 9:00 AM in Oak Park
. Standard board meetings typically take place at 9:00 AM in the Board Room, 16th Floor, 175 W. Jackson Blvd., Chicago, IL 60604. 
Northern Illinois Transit Authority (.gov)
Upcoming Meeting & Budget Vote
Next Board Meeting: December 10, 2026, at 9:00 AM (Oak Park).
Budget Vote: The board is scheduled to vote on the proposed 2027 regional transit operating budget and 5-year capital program.
Public Comment Deadline: Comments on the proposed budget close on December 4, 2026. 
Northern Illinois Transit Authority (.gov)
 +1
Meeting Access & Materials
Agendas & Records: View past and upcoming board and committee materials on the Northern Illinois Transit Authority Meeting Materials page. 
Northern Illinois Transit Authority (.gov)
 +1
Board Governance: Learn more about the 20-member board and advisory bodies on the Northern Illinois Transit Authority Boards and Committees page. 
Northern Illinois Transit Authority (.gov)
Livestreams & Recordings: Watch past and live board streams via the NITA Board Meetings YouTube channel. 
YouTube
·NITA Board Meetings
Public Comment & Accommodations: Email communications@nita.illinois.gov by noon the day before a meeting to submit comments, or call (312) 913-3219 for disability accommodations. 
Northern Illinois Transit Authority (.gov)
Recent Highlights (November 12, 2026 Meeting)
2027 Budget & Fares: Discussed the proposed 2027 budget with no fare increases, expanded reduced-fare programs, and plans to eliminate CTA–Pace transfer fees in 2027. 
YouTube
·NITA Board Meetings
Service & Safety: Highlighted service hour expansions across CTA, Metra, and Pace, alongside safety initiatives and the rollout of the Safe Ride incident reporting app. 
YouTube
·NITA Board Meetings
Advisory Councils: Applications closed for the Rider Advisory Council and ADA Advisory Council, with final lists slated for board approval in December.

·NITA Board Meetings
